verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official MCP server that works with Claude, Cursor, Codex and VS Code. Through it, an agent can investigate destination delivery errors, monitor pipelines, and write and test transformations. Its APIs also let you "programmatically manage your RudderStack connections, transformations and other RudderStack features." Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sources and destinations can be created and wired via API/MCP (only "manage connections" is stated), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management.
